Appointments from Midtown Phoenix take place at 6022 N 16th St, Phoenix, AZ 85016. Call 602-607-5686 if you need help selecting a service or planning a group visit. The salon is open Monday–Saturday 9:30 AM–7 PM and Sunday 10 AM–5 PM; available booking times may end earlier. Free on-site parking is available. Plan your visit · Custom Nail Art

Reserve art according to what must be painted, placed, or finished.

A Midtown Phoenix nail-art guest should define the base service before discussing the design. Natural nails, a gel manicure, Builder Gel, acrylic, and Gel-X require different preparation. Then identify the number of detailed nails, the non-negotiable motif, palette, French or chrome elements, and whether old product or repairs are part of the visit. References guide the artist, but they do not replace an accurate time category.

Another option · Aprés Gel-X

Gel-X can add uniform length when the design calls for it.

Reserve old-set removal and a complete new set with length, shape, finish, and art. Gel-X is not merely an add-on to the design appointment.
